name: Solar Wind Chime Canyon
description: A canyon lined with colossal chimes that resonate when solar wind passes, lighting up with each note.
prompt: Wide canyon with towering metal chimes — bronze, silver, glass — suspended from the rim. Streams of solar wind (visualized as glowing particle streams) flow through, striking chimes that flare with color-coded light. Epic scale, dramatic lighting, 8K.
caption: Hear the sun sing through stone and metal. 🎶☀️ #SolarWindChimeCanyon
